scope: Source-ready extension of the signed-out guest native Settings controls driver; no native browser run or release in this lane.
change: The trusted UI sequence saves the specified 65001 first against an HTTP observation fixture bound to that exact port, then saves inclusive ports 1 and 65535. It reads the Chrome local-storage override and displayed input after each Save and Settings panel reload, then checks that rejected 65536 leaves saved 65535 intact. The observed-worker rediscovery, blank-clear, panel reload, and disposable-profile cleanup checks remain in place.
forcing_breaks: A fixture that cannot bind 65001 fails before the case; an ephemeral substitute cannot silently satisfy the first specified step.
A client that rejects either inclusive endpoint cannot reach its post-Save storage and reload assertions.
A client that updates only the visible input without persisting the override fails the storage read.
A client that applies 65536 or silently alters the last accepted value fails preservation of 65535.
A client that fails to clear the override fails the existing blank and reload checks.
remaining_gaps: The extended driver still needs a fresh, receipt-verified native Chrome execution before the 65001 and boundary checks receive acceptance credit.
A healthy desktop-engine connection remains unverified because the existing observed port returns an intentional 503 rather than a fabricated health response.
This guest-only case does not establish member, admin, or full Settings health.
